# UnlockTextArea <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Text Areas](BlitzPlus-Text-Areas)

</div>


```blitzbasic
UnlockTextArea:Void textarea:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `textarea` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a text area. |

## Description

Allows the text area to be redrawn again after [LockTextArea](LockTextArea) and shows what changed.
